name: The Forest Deep
source:
In a deep forest stands a path, once a common route for travelers, that is now avoided at all costs. Lately, it seems anyone who enters the forest never exits - including the most recent missing person, a renowned young knight. Thus, the path is no longer walked, and the townsfolk have lost hope of finding those gone to the forest... Except for a young magical prodigy, determined to find their brother - or at the least, answers. 

They might get more questions than answers...

[From [url=https://myosotisghost.itch.io/the-forest-deep]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
森林深处有一条小路，曾经是旅行者的常用路线，但现在人们不惜一切代价避开它。最近，似乎任何进入森林的人都永远不会离开——包括最近失踪的人，一位著名的年轻骑士。因此，这条路不再有人行走，镇民们也失去了寻找那些去森林的人的希望……除了一位年轻的魔法神童，他决心找到他们的兄弟——或者至少找到答案。

他们可能会得到更多的问题而不是答案……

[来自[url=https://myosotisghost.itch.io/the-forest-deep]itch.io[/url]]
